hero.description: Colors are not just pigments. They’re emotions that decided to stay on the canvas. Each piece is a conversation — between light, silence, and you.

about.title: Painting is my way to listen to light.
about.text: I create paintings where color becomes memory and silence becomes space. Every brushstroke is a conversation with light as it comes and goes. I search for the moment between stillness and motion — where the breath of a painting begins.

gallery.title: GALLERY
gallery.intro: A collection of works capturing different periods and styles of my art.

cta.title: Explore More

exhibitions.title: SERIES
exhibitions.description: Each series embodies a distinct theme – from introspective portraits to abstract landscapes. These cycles are not just paintings, but dialogues between color, light, and inner space.
exhibitions.cta_text: Explore all series in the complete exhibition – stories bound by light, color, and introspection. Every painting is a fragment of a larger search for balance between emotion and silence.
